# ETF Flows MCP Server

> Open-source MCP server for daily net flows of US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs. The website, API docs and the no-install remote MCP server live at https://yasinozen.com/etf-flows/

- Website and data pages: https://yasinozen.com/etf-flows/
- Remote MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP): https://yasinozen.com/etf-flows/mcp
- MCP setup guide: https://yasinozen.com/etf-flows/mcp-server/
- REST API docs: https://yasinozen.com/etf-flows/api/
- Full site index for LLMs: https://yasinozen.com/etf-flows/llms.txt
